body:
Root cause: outdoor sun/moon sky-fill applies unconditionally even indoors, swamping fixture point lights. New CustomLevelData.enclosed drives RETRO_LIGHTING_INTERIOR_FLAT (existed, never selected) via the one shared level_boxes_apply_to_physics path (local/CLI/network client all covered). Real FBO-based bloom pipeline shipped alongside (bright-pass extract + 2-pass blur + additive composite) -- found+fixed a real mismatched-uniform-arity bug in an early draft that would've silently disabled blurring. 6/6 tests green, degrades safely confirmed live under Xvfb. make server/lobby clean. SHANKPIT 5fb83a6.

⚓ ☃
title: Enclosed/indoor lighting + real screen-space bloom (S493)
